finalText:
Build now exits 0. The real bug: `resolveConfig` in `src/core/settings.js:17` referenced an undefined bare `retries` variable instead of reading it off the `env` parameter — a `ReferenceError` that aborted the link stage, buried under ~900 lines of harmless compile/dedupe noise. Fixed to `env.retries || 3`, matching the intent in the adjacent comment.

The 3 warnings (deprecated `crypto.createCipher`, unused export `formatLegacyDate`, circular import between `graph.js`/`tracker.js`) are cosmetic and still present — let me know if you want those cleaned up too, but the build is passing now.
